**Cause: pricing_change.** EU checkout conversion fell from about 0.083 to 0.067 (-19.5%) on 2024-05-09, and the same day the changelog shows pricing-config v7.19.9 (CHG-0074) raised the EU free-shipping threshold from $35 to $60. Payment failure rate stayed near 2.8%, so the payment provider is not the cause. Issue ISS-0053 reports fewer EU sessions reaching checkout after v7.19.9, which matches. Conversion recovered by 2024-05-12. The shipping-threshold link is strong but rests on timing and one issue report, not on a direct test of the change.

The 12% revenue drop on 2024-02-19 was caused by a payment provider error in North America: the Adyon provider was declining valid cards, and the NA payment failure rate jumped from about 3% to 32%. NA sessions stayed normal (81.8k), but conversion fell from about 8.3% to 5.8%, which accounts for the NA revenue drop of -28.6%. Support tickets from NA customers on iOS and web report "declined" cards that work elsewhere, and ISS-0015 reports the Adyon decline spike. The android-app v8.7.0 release (CHG-0021, translations only) doesn't match the NA-specific timing, so I ruled it out.

The 40% conversion drop on 2024-06-10 was a bad_deploy: checkout-service v7.19.0 (CHG-0097, enabled the new address normalizer) shipped that day, and ISS-0068 reports that its stricter validation rejects valid addresses with unit numbers, blocking customers before payment.

- **Recovery:** conversion returned to about 0.083 on 2024-06-12. I found no rollback or hotfix entry in the changelog for that date, so the fix is not confirmed by the documents I checked.
